title: Close and bolt a double-door enclosure whose astragal forces the leaf order
instruction: Close the blue-grey enclosure's two doors and throw the door bolt.
context: On a no-centre-post electrical cabinet the active door's astragal overlaps the seam, so the passive door must shut first, and its bolt must be thrown into the header keeper; electrical safety practice (NFPA 70E) counts equipment as in normal operation only with doors closed and secured. Done by: electricians (47-2111.00), commercial and industrial equipment repairers (49-2094.00), general maintenance and repair workers (49-9071.00).
setup: Positions in mm in one frame shared by all three mechanisms: origin on the table top 215 mm in front of the arm bases and midway between them (world 0.215, 0, 0.7475 m, yaw 0), in the plane of the closed doors; x away from the robot, y to the robot's left, z up. Doors open toward the robot. Friction 0.8 static, 0.6 dynamic everywhere. No other objects. ENCLOSURE (fixed to the table), powder-coated steel, blue-grey RGB (0.12,0.32,0.52), boxes as centre / size: floor (70,0,3) / 140x252x6; roof (76,0,167) / 128x252x6; back (137,0,85) / 6x252x170; sides (74,+-123,85) / 132x6x170; door-stop flanges (13,+-114,85) / 6x12x158; header bars (13,0,10) and (13,0,160) / 6x216x6. Keeper, bare steel RGB (0.48,0.52,0.57), a 16 mm square bore 12 mm tall centred (-10,40,174): walls (-20,40,174) and (0,40,174) / 4x24x12, (-10,30,174) and (-10,50,174) / 16x4x12; rear bridge to the header (7,40,174) / 10x24x12. Spring catch: brass ball, radius 3 mm, 3 g, at (-15.8,40,167), slides along x -4..0 mm, spring 300 N/m toward +x (rest +3.8 mm), damping 0.05 N s/m, starts at 0. LEFT (PASSIVE) DOOR: fixed painted-steel hinge pin cylinder radius 3, height 140 at (0,120,85). Leaf, 180 g with its hardware, hinged about z at (0,120,85), range -100..0 degrees (0 closed), starts 50 degrees open (-50), damping 0.020 N m s/rad, no spring: painted-steel sheet (0,61,85) / 3x118x152; brass pull bar cylinder radius 4, height 50 at (-14,24,92) on brass standoffs (-7,24,70) and (-7,24,114) / 14x8x6; two bare-steel bolt guide rings at z=125 and z=148, each four boxes (-17.5,40) and (-2.5,40) / 3x18x5 plus (-10,32.5) and (-10,47.5) / 12x3x5. Bolt, 20 g, bare steel with a brass post, slides up along z 0..15 mm, starts down (0), damping 0.020 N s/m; at 0: rod radius 4 from z=120 to 149.5, neck radius 3 from 149.5 to 154.5, rod radius 4 from 154.5 to 158, rounded tip sphere radius 4 at (-10,40,158), arm box (-34,40,122) / 48x6x6, brass post cylinder radius 8, height 25 at (-58,40,137.5). The bolt does not collide with its own leaf; the guides are visual and the slide joint keeps the rod on its axis. RIGHT (ACTIVE) DOOR: fixed painted-steel hinge pin radius 3, height 140 at (0,-120,85). Leaf, 200 g with its hardware, hinged about z at (0,-120,85), range 0..100 degrees (0 closed), starts 70 degrees open (+70), damping 0.020 N m s/rad, no spring: painted-steel sheet (0,-61,85) / 3x118x152; brass pull bar radius 4, height 50 at (-14,-24,92) on brass standoffs (-7,-24,70) and (-7,-24,114) / 14x8x6; bare-steel astragal strip (-9,5,85) / 3x18x152, covering the passive sheet's free edge 6 mm in front of it; bare-steel astragal spacer strip (-4.5,-5,85) / 6x4x152. The README lists the same colliders as a table.
scoring: Hinge angles; for a tape measure, a leaf's free-edge gap from its closed line is 118 mm x sin(angle), about 2 mm per degree. 1.0: both leaves within 1.0 degree of closed (free edge within 2 mm of its closed line) and the bolt raised at least 10 mm of its 15 mm travel (its rounded tip at least 4 mm inside the 12 mm tall keeper bore), with both grippers at least 30 mm from each leaf's and the bolt's bounding box, hinge speeds below 0.05 rad/s and bolt speed below 0.010 m/s, all continuously for 1 s. 0.75: the same closed and bolted geometry while held, moving, or before the 1 s has passed. 0.5: both leaves within 1.0 degree of closed, bolt raised less than 10 mm. 0.25: passive leaf within 1.0 degree of closed and bolt raised at least 10 mm, active leaf more than 1.0 degree open. Otherwise 0, including the untouched start, a passive leaf more than 1.0 degree open, and a raised bolt on an open passive leaf. Sticky 0 for the rest of the trial, even after the doors are later closed correctly: the passive leaf 4.5 to 8 degrees open (free edge about 9 to 16 mm out) while the active leaf is within 1.0 degree of closed, for at least 0.25 s, i.e. the passive leaf forced against the front of a shut astragal (contact at 6.46 degrees). Passing through the band for less than 0.25 s, or with the active leaf more than 1 degree open, does not count, and a passive leaf ajar up to 2.9 degrees behind the shut astragal is not a violation. Online, speeds are joint-value changes between 20 Hz steps; offline static layouts use reported velocities and assume release. Success: score 1.0 held a further 1 s.
reset_notes: Set the passive (left) leaf 50 degrees open, the active (right) leaf 70 degrees open, the bolt down at 0 and the catch at 0, all at rest; clear the scorer's sticky flag and hold timers. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid steel primitives model the astragal overlap, the bolt and keeper, and a spring-ball catch that engages a neck on the bolt rod. Hinges and slides are passive, with damping and end stops. The active leaf has no latch or lock and is held shut only by hinge damping; the passive leaf has a single top bolt (no bottom bolt). Thin-sheet bending, seals, electrical and fire hazards, certification and full-size door inertia are omitted.
